add_rewards_called_with_reentrant_token.meaning: addRewards is invoked with a token whose transferFrom can re-enter the Distributor
add_rewards_called_with_reentrant_token.checkpoint: before addRewards executes its external transferFrom

reentrancy_guard_absent.meaning: addRewards and claimRewards lack a nonReentrant guard and transferFrom is not ordered before bookkeeping
reentrancy_guard_absent.checkpoint: before addRewards executes its external transferFrom

transfer_from_completed_before_bookkeepi.meaning: the external transferFrom in addRewards completes before reward accounting is updated
transfer_from_completed_before_bookkeepi.checkpoint: during addRewards execution, at the point reward accounting is updated

reentrancy_window_open.meaning: a clear reentrancy window exists that can be used for griefing
reentrancy_window_open.checkpoint: during addRewards execution after reward accounting update and before external transferFrom

assumptions: The external transferFrom is the only external call in addRewards relevant to the reentrancy window.
claimRewards is reachable during the reentrant call.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is an authorized caller of addRewards or claimRewards.
Report does not specify concrete amounts or numeric bounds for the accounting increase.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario, not an inevitable effect.
The reentrancy window is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition.
Monetary extraction is described as conditional and is not formalized here.
